HUNT VALLEY, Md., April 30, 2026 – Textron Systems Corporation, a Textron Inc. (NYSE:TXT) company,
announced today a contract award from the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) to produce and deliver
multiple TSUNAMI ® Uncrewed Surface Vessels (USVs), which will be used to support the U.S. Navy
Fleet Experimentation (FLEX) exercise in Key West, Florida and provide three months of joint
operations with SOUTHCOM and the U.S. Navy Fourth Fleet. Under the contract, Textron Systems will
provide the long dwell TSUNAMI interceptor USVs and Field Service Representatives (FSRs) to the FLEX
exercise, demonstrating cooperative intelligence, surveillance reconnaissance and targeting (ISR-T)
with its Aerosonde ® 4.7 VTOL UAS off a Littoral Combat Ship (LCS). The exercise will also
demonstrate manned-unmanned surface warfare with Invariant Corporation’s Surface-to-Air Kinetic
Engagement (STAKE) system. The TSUNAMI family of autonomous maritime surface vessels are designed to
meet the needs of the U.S.

# When performance & reliability are not optional

Keep your apps fast & reliable - load testing, scalable Playwright E2E testing, and production
monitoring in one toolkit. Incrementally adoptable, and built to work with coding agents.

[Sign up free][9][Docs][10]

Let your favorite AI analyze whether Artillery may be a good fit for your team

[Ask ChatGPT][11][Ask Claude][12][Ask Perplexity][13]
Artillery Cloud[Artillery Cloud · Load test view]Artillery CLI
[Artillery CLI]

Learn how **Code Wizards** load tested Heroic Labs’ Nakama to **two million concurrent players**
with Artillery and AWS.

[Read more ↗][14][[AWS]][15]

## What can you do with Artillery?

## Scalable Playwright E2E testing

Run & debug Playwright E2E tests faster. For teams running Playwright tests at scale.

**Get started**

Get prompt for your AI agent

[Read the docs][16]

### Reporting & collaboration
* One central dashboard for all Playwright test results
* Automatic tracking of [Web Vitals][17] on all pages
* GitHub Actions integration with PR comments
* Test reports linked back to GitHub PRs and branches automatically

### Debug issues faster
* Traces, screenshots, and attachments in every report
* Rich context for your coding agent to investigate & fix bugs

### Turbo runner ^{BETA}
* Run large Playwright test suites 10x faster with automatic sharding & parallelization
* Use Artillery’s cloud runners, or your own infrastructure on AWS or Azure

## Load testing

Make sure your apps & APIs scale and stay performant under load.

**Get started**

Get prompt for your AI agent

[Read the docs][18]

### Playwright-native load testing
* Reuse existing Playwright tests for browser-based load testing
* [Web Vitals][19] metrics automatically reported
* Scale to tens of thousands of headless browsers with distributed load testing

### Zero to production-grade fast
* Load test anything: HTTP APIs, GraphQL services, Socket.IO apps and more
* Out-of-the-box integrations for CICD and monitoring with OpenTelemetry
* Coding agents already know how to write and analyze Artillery load tests

### Designed for testing at scale
* Distributed load testing is built-in
* Run tests from your own AWS or Azure account using pay-as-you-go serverless infrastructure
* Scale up to millions of virtual users and requests
* Built-in cost reporting for all tests

## Synthetic checks & monitoring

Continuously monitor key user journeys with browser-based or API checks.

Coming soon

### Catch & triage production issues early
* Reuse Playwright code for continuous monitoring
* Run checks in CI or on a cron schedule
* Track performance & uptime of your web app or API over time
* Get alerts via email, Slack, or PagerDuty

### Designed for scale
* Run checks from 12 different regions (US, EU, APAC)
* Run on Artillery’s cloud runners or your own serverless infra on AWS or Azure

## Helping scale-ups and enterprises ship with performance & reliability

**Code Wizards** load tested Heroic Labs’ Nakama to **two million concurrent players** with
Artillery and AWS.

unlimited scale with Artillery.

Artillery.

## NEWS

[ [BAYRAKTAR KIZILELMA STRIKES WITH SUPERSONIC MISSILE] ][40]
[BAYRAKTAR KIZILELMA STRIKES WITH SUPERSONIC MISSILE][41]

The Bayraktar KIZILELMA Unmanned Fighter Aircraft, which marked the beginning of a new chapter in
the history of global aviation, successfully completed its first firing test with an air-to-ground
supersonic missile. During the test, which took place in Merzifon, KIZILELMA S2 successfully struck

Indigenously and originally developed by Baykar, the next-generation kamikaze UAV K2 and Sivrisinek
loitering munition unveiled the combat concept of the future during a demonstration held in Keşan.
The tests showcased AI-supported swarm autonomy, GNSS-independent navigation, automatic target
detection, and strike capabilities. The K2 Kamikaze UAV and Sivrisinek will be exhibited to the
public for the first time at SAHA 2026, taking place on 5-9 May.

with communications and navigation capabilities, has successfully reached its designated orbit and
commenced operations.

# Transit Time Finder

The Transit Time Finder provides you with the delivery date for a selected service.

You are required to select the Blue Dart service required by you, the Origin and Destination City
and the pick up date and time below.

To confirm if the service required by you is available, for the origin and destination selected,
please check with our [Location Finder][45]. For detailed information on our services, refer to our
[Service Guide][46].

**NOTE 1 :** The scheduled delivery date given is subject to the Terms And Conditions Of Carriage,
details of which are available in our [Service Guide][47].

**NOTE 2 :** Some locations in or around the city could be out of delivery area and may require
extra time for delivery - [Contact Customer Service][48].

**NOTE 3 :** Transit Time arrived at are on best estimate basis and it is advisable to [Contact
Customer Service][49] for your definite shipping needs.

**NOTE 4 :** Non documents shipments are subject to stricter customs, excise, and/or regulatory
checks which may cause delays - please refer further to disclaimer section.

# Price Finder

The Price Finder helps you to calculate your shipping charges for your service type needs.

Charges will be based on the weight of the shipment in kgs or fractions thereof and may be
assessible either on the gross weight of the shipment or the volume/dimensional weight of the
shipment - whichever is higher.

The chargeable weight may be expressed as fractions of a kg. such as 0.25 kgs or 0.5 kgs and may go
upto 9999 kgs.

If you wish to contact our centralized customer service [click here][50].

For information on Fuel Surcharge [click here][51].

# Transit Time Finder

The Transit Time Finder provides you with the delivery date for a selected service.

You are required to select the Blue Dart service required by you, the Origin and Destination City
and the pick up date and time below.

To confirm if the service required by you is available, for the origin and destination selected,

details of which are available in our [Service Guide][47].

extra time for delivery - [Contact Customer Service][48].

Customer Service][49] for your definite shipping needs.

**NOTE 4 :** Non documents shipments are subject to stricter customs, excise, and/or regulatory
checks which may cause delays - please refer further to disclaimer section.

# Price Finder

The Price Finder helps you to calculate your shipping charges for your service type needs.

Charges will be based on the weight of the shipment in kgs or fractions thereof and may be
assessible either on the gross weight of the shipment or the volume/dimensional weight of the
shipment - whichever is higher.

The chargeable weight may be expressed as fractions of a kg. such as 0.25 kgs or 0.5 kgs and may go
upto 9999 kgs.

system. Understanding the different types of ammunition available in the game is crucial to survive
and thrive in Tarkov.

One important resource for players is an ammo reference page. An ammo reference page is a guide that
provides detailed information on the different types of ammunition available in the game. This
information typically includes the name of the ammunition, a description of its characteristics, and
key statistics such as damage, penetration, and recoil.

The information on an ammo reference page can be used by players to help them make informed
decisions about which ammunition to use with their weapons. For example, some ammunition may be more
powerful but have more recoil, while others may be less powerful but have less recoil. By comparing

playstyle and the situation they are facing. The reference page should also include information
about the specific guns that it is compatible with, bullets size and other details that might be
relevant for specific players goals.

In addition to its practical use, an ammo reference page can also be a valuable resource for players
who are interested in the lore and realism of the game. It helps to understand the in-game's world
armament and makes the game experience more immersive. In summary, an ammo reference page is an
essential tool for players of Escape from Tarkov.

It provides detailed information on the different types of ammunition available in the game,
allowing players to make informed decisions about which ammunition to use.

With the right ammunition, players can increase the performance of their weapons and increase their
chances of survival in the intense and realistic world of Tarkov.

### Why an Ammo Reference Page for Escape from Tarkov?

Escape from Tarkov is a first-person shooter game known for its realistic weapons and ammunition
system. Understanding the different types of ammunition available in the game is crucial to survive
and thrive in Tarkov.

One important resource for players is an ammo reference page. An ammo reference page is a guide that
provides detailed information on the different types of ammunition available in the game. This
information typically includes the name of the ammunition, a description of its characteristics, and
key statistics such as damage, penetration, and recoil.

The information on an ammo reference page can be used by players to help them make informed
decisions about which ammunition to use with their weapons. For example, some ammunition may be more
powerful but have more recoil, while others may be less powerful but have less recoil. By comparing
the statistics of different types of ammunition, players can choose the one that best suits their
playstyle and the situation they are facing. The reference page should also include information
about the specific guns that it is compatible with, bullets size and other details that might be
relevant for specific players goals.

In addition to its practical use, an ammo reference page can also be a valuable resource for players
who are interested in the lore and realism of the game. It helps to understand the in-game's world
armament and makes the game experience more immersive. In summary, an ammo reference page is an
essential tool for players of Escape from Tarkov.

It provides detailed information on the different types of ammunition available in the game,
allowing players to make informed decisions about which ammunition to use.

With the right ammunition, players can increase the performance of their weapons and increase their
chances of survival in the intense and realistic world of Tarkov.

Smith & Wesson, Marlin, Remington, Browning, Ithaca, Iver Johnson, Walther, Mauser, Beretta, SIG,
and many others, for professional gunsmiths worldwide.

The searchable library contains original blueprints for AK-47, 1911, AR-15, Luger, M1 Garand, M14,
MP44, STG44, P38, UZI parts, etc. We have Armorer's Manuals for Remington, SIG, H&K, Glock, FN, IWI,
Blaser, RSAF, Webley, Colt, Smith & Wesson, H&R 1871, Winchester, and many other.

Whether you're restoring an antique firearm, repairing a modern rifle, identifying replacement
parts, or researching historical firearms, Firearms Guide provides fast access to professional
reference materials.

SAVE YOUR TIME & GET INSTANT ACCESS TO ALL MATERIALS and start zooming in on your screen to see the
smallest gun parts on diagrams or exploded views and parts dimensions on blueprints. Even the
smallest gun parts zoomed in on your large computer screen now look larger than in reality or any
other book or manual. Read gun manuals, old catalogs, and parts lists on your screen, or PRINT OUT
as many as you like for your collection or your gun shop customers.

FIREARMS IDENTIFICATION

The database includes a Gun Make Codes, Marks, Crests, Stamps, Proofs, and Trademarks Graphic Guide
for easier antique gun identification, and an Ammunition Dimensions (Case & Bullet) Guide.

Available to all gunsmiths 24/7. Save time, get all the help you need instantly, exactly when you
need it, every time you work on a customer’s gun. Become a more efficient and more profitable
gunsmith. Print manuals for your customers and make them even more satisfied with your services.

GUN VALUES

Gun Values for modern and antique guns (based on the 100% - 30% condition ratings) are provided for
professionals in the gun trade, gun shops, and gun collectors. Now you can quickly and precisely
estimate the values of all guns in your collection, from your home, shop, office, or gun show 24/7.
When you sell a gun, print out the manual for it and provide it with the gun to your buyer.

FREE UPDATES

Our database is constantly growing with updates that are free for our users.

Search guns privately, find gun values privately, print out gun schematics, gun blueprints, gun
manuals, and antique gun catalogs privately, without tracking, without search engines archiving your
searches and downloads; and then selling them to U.S. agencies (no warrant needed). No targeted ads.
No cookies. No personal data collecting. No search history storing. 100% user privacy! We are Pro
2nd Amendment!

## About

[**Gun Wiki**][102] is a **Wikia** that was founded in January 2006 by [Jocke Pirat][103]. This
Wikia is a website that anyone can edit and improve, specific to [Guns][104] and [Firearms][105].
Right now, you can edit **[3,479][106] different articles** about this subject and can create many,
many more.

We encourage you to become part of our little community. We have a [Community Blog][107] where you
can find out what other people are writing about. Also there is a [Community Portal][108] that links
you to other important pages.

Gun Wiki is growing so there will be new things added here on the Home Page from time to time.

On behalf of Gun Wiki, thanks for stopping by and we hope you find a home here, [SgtMajGW G.
Glover][109][^{Semper Fi}][110]

# Home

[ Sign In to Save Save ][58] [ Edit ][59]
* [ History ][60]
* [ Purge ][61]
* [ Talk (0) ][62]

Welcome Operator! This is the official **IRON NEST Wiki**!

Is this the Brutal Dieselpunk Heavy Artillery Simulator you’ve been waiting for? Measure, Calculate,
Load, Fire! Come along to the heavy artillery madness you want. Take orders, measure, make every
shot count. Demo now available at the current nest fest: visit at [https://discord.gg/qhaUtMWb][63]

## Description

The [Iron nest][64] is Unity-engine powered game where you are stationed as the operator in charge
of a massive artillery vessel, accurately measuring and delivering fatal shots on every coordinated
target. You are positioned inside a naval-like turret with 2, 800mm barrels who each can be loaded
with different ammunitions. Your job as the operator is to carry out orders from high command, as
you are given orders, typically sent through a type writer in the back of the turret, you must
triangulate different enemy targets kilometers apart on a table map. HCHE, HE, AP, STAR, PHOSGENE,
TEAR, SMOKE, each target needs a different shell, underground targets need AP, civil riots need
TEAR/PHOSGENE, enemy artillery batteries need HE/HCHE, make every shot count. Calculate, load, and
FIRE.

## History

In this alternate timeline, history took a sharp and fateful turn. The assassination attempt on
Archduke Franz Ferdinand failed, and with it, the spark that once ignited the Great War was snuffed
out—at least, for a time. Years later, it would be the Spanish Civil War that set the world ablaze.
Foreign powers, eager to test their latest weapons and doctrines, poured men, machines, and ambition
into the conflict. It was here that the engines of war began to turn once more, grinding inexorably
toward a new, far more terrible global confrontation. But this war was not our World War. The world
had changed in ways subtle and profound: The Monarchies Endured. Without the Great War to sweep them
away, Europe’s crowns still gleamed upon royal brows. Kings and emperors remained the architects of
destiny. The Skies Remained Silent. Aircraft never proved their worth beyond the role of artillery
scouts; the dream of air superiority faded into a novelty of parades and pageantry. The Dreadnought
Obsession. The naval arms race unchecked by treaties or tragedy, pushed nations to forge ever-larger
guns and turrets. Yet rapid innovation soon rendered these steel leviathans obsolete, leaving
stockpiles of colossal armaments with no ships to bear them. Thus began the Iron Nest Initiative, an
audacious effort to repurpose naval power for the land. From the forgotten arsenals and rusting
docks rose the first Iron Nest Prototypes, mechanical behemoths born of imperial ambition and
desperation alike. And with their awakening, the world once again marched toward war.

shot count. Demo now available at the current nest fest: visit at [https://discord.gg/qhaUtMWb][63]

## Description

The [Iron nest][64] is Unity-engine powered game where you are stationed as the operator in charge
of a massive artillery vessel, accurately measuring and delivering fatal shots on every coordinated
target. You are positioned inside a naval-like turret with 2, 800mm barrels who each can be loaded
with different ammunitions. Your job as the operator is to carry out orders from high command, as
you are given orders, typically sent through a type writer in the back of the turret, you must
triangulate different enemy targets kilometers apart on a table map. HCHE, HE, AP, STAR, PHOSGENE,
TEAR, SMOKE, each target needs a different shell, underground targets need AP, civil riots need
TEAR/PHOSGENE, enemy artillery batteries need HE/HCHE, make every shot count. Calculate, load, and
FIRE.

## History

In this alternate timeline, history took a sharp and fateful turn. The assassination attempt on
Archduke Franz Ferdinand failed, and with it, the spark that once ignited the Great War was snuffed
out—at least, for a time. Years later, it would be the Spanish Civil War that set the world ablaze.
Foreign powers, eager to test their latest weapons and doctrines, poured men, machines, and ambition
into the conflict. It was here that the engines of war began to turn once more, grinding inexorably
toward a new, far more terrible global confrontation. But this war was not our World War. The world
had changed in ways subtle and profound: The Monarchies Endured. Without the Great War to sweep them
away, Europe’s crowns still gleamed upon royal brows. Kings and emperors remained the architects of
destiny. The Skies Remained Silent. Aircraft never proved their worth beyond the role of artillery
scouts; the dream of air superiority faded into a novelty of parades and pageantry. The Dreadnought
Obsession. The naval arms race unchecked by treaties or tragedy, pushed nations to forge ever-larger
guns and turrets. Yet rapid innovation soon rendered these steel leviathans obsolete, leaving
stockpiles of colossal armaments with no ships to bear them. Thus began the Iron Nest Initiative, an
audacious effort to repurpose naval power for the land. From the forgotten arsenals and rusting
docks rose the first Iron Nest Prototypes, mechanical behemoths born of imperial ambition and
desperation alike. And with their awakening, the world once again marched toward war.

      │km blast radius.                 │civil riots, infantry divisions and mechanised targets.

## Measuring

As the operator, your job is to accurately measure the distance between your station and the enemy
target, most preferred usage of measuring would be triangulating with different reference points on
the map with the location given to you by high command. When you first enter the game, whether if
its challenge mode, or the tutorial, you are met with a 20 kilometer table map stationed in the
middle of the turret. To measure, first press left click and drag it across the given distance
between you and the target. When you are sure of your distance and bearing, let go. You are left
with a straight arrow with the distance, and bearing that you must dial into the ballistic
calculator to recieve your elevation which you may later use to accurately hit your target. Speaking
of the ballistic calculator...

## Ballistic Calculator

The Ballistic Calculator is a range finder which tells you the elevation of your gun to hit the
target. The current way to use it is as followed: Dial in the range using the handle, and do not
worry, as you do not require your bearing for this step. Make sure it is exactly as it is in your
clipboard, down to the decimal, next, pick the amount of powder charges that you desire. The amount
of powder charges may interfere with your elevation with each powder charge adding more power to the
shot as you go. It is recommended to pick the first number of powder charges allowed by your
ballistic calculator. Finally, crank the lever, and recieve your elevation. Make every shot count.

## Loading ammunition

On your left and your right you may notice ammo racks with different types of ammunition. When you
climb up the steps you come across a hand switch, which is used to switch the types of ammunition on
the rack. The first step of loading is to select your ammunition, next drive the ammunition into the
barrel with the handle next to the hand switch, drop the calculated amount of powder charges and
drive them in too. Wait for the animation to finish and now..

## Bearing of the turret

In the front right side of the control room, there is a handle and a wheel. If you want to adjust
your bearing you may use the wheel, otherwise you use the handle to quickly turn the turret to your
desired degree and match it up with your clipboard information. Not much to explain just match it up
with your given bearing on the clipboard.

## Elevating the barrels

The final step of the process, on the front left side of the control room there are 2 wheels both
for the left and right cannon and 2 handles which are locked for until you load the ammunition.
Usually when you finish loading they automatically go up and give you an elevation close to the one
on your clipboard. Use the wheels to adjust the elevation while the trigger levers drop for your
confirmation. When everything is set up you may notice switches on a dashboard and 3 hand switches.
You aren't required to turn all the switches on, but for realism you may choose to do so. When you
are ready pull the left or right switch and finally fire your cannons with the switch in the middle.

## Credits

All credits goes to the testers reporting bugs and tweaking the game to perfection, Nick,
Scream_Wattson Making the models, using the game engine and making a masterpiece of an artillery
game for us to play.

## How you can help us

Join the discord and nest fest, claim your keys, report bugs, and enjoy playing the game.

## For everyday writing

**Microsoft Word** remains a familiar [office suites][186] staple, showing how Microsoft Word
continues to function as a reliable [productivity ][187]and **document management** tool today. This
app still shapes how people draft letters, reports, and long-form content, balancing powerful
formatting options with an interface that feels approachable for everyday writing needs.

Microsoft Word stands out as more than just a typing space, particularly within **teaching &
training**, **client communication**, and broader **document management** workflows. The app has
matured into a dependable writing environment where collaboration, layout control, and file
compatibility are just as important as the fundamentals of word processing.

### A trusted tool for written work 

Microsoft Word benefits from a **clean interface**,** logical menus**, and **consistent shortcuts**
that make navigation intuitive for both beginners and experienced users. Core tasks like formatting
text, managing styles, and inserting tables feel streamlined and predictable. However, the depth of
options can feel **overwhelming at first**, especially when advanced layout, review, or reference
tools appear during simple writing sessions for new users exploring features gradually over time
comfortably. 

As a productivity and office suites tool, the program** handles large documents **reliably,
including reports with images, footnotes, tables, and tracked changes.** Real-time collaboration**
is smooth and practical, particularly for shared editing, commenting, and version awareness. That
said, **performance** **can** **dip** slightly when documents become extremely complex or heavily
formatted, which may slow editing momentum during extended work sessions for teams, students, and
professional writing environments overall today. 

### Collaboration, cloud integration, and constant evolution 

Modern versions of Microsoft Word emphasize teamwork through Microsoft 365 integration. Files saved
to OneDrive allow multiple users to edit simultaneously while tracking changes in real time.
Comments and revision history make collaborative editing smoother, supporting **real time
collaboration** for remote teams and shared projects. This cloud functionality ensures documents
remain accessible across devices, from desktops to mobile apps. Still, reliance on online features
require constant internet connection. 

Updates have introduced** AI assisted writing features** through **Microsoft** **Copilot**
integration. These updates added content suggestions, automatic summaries, and improved rewriting
assistance directly inside documents. Patch notes also included performance optimizations for large
files, improved **PDF** **editing** **support**, expanded accessibility tools such as improved
screen reader compatibility, and enhanced collaboration stability. **Security** **updates**
strengthened protection against malicious documents, reflecting Microsoft’s ongoing focus on **AI
powered writing assistance** while maintaining document safety and reliability.

The everyday standard for modern writing 

Microsoft Word continues to prove why it remains the default choice for document creation across
schools, businesses, and personal use. Its blend of familiar tools, powerful formatting, and
evolving collaboration features keeps it relevant in a changing digital workspace. While advanced
options and cloud reliance may not suit everyone, Word still delivers a dependable writing
environment that balances tradition, productivity, and modern workflow demands effectively.

## For everyday writing

**Microsoft Word** remains a familiar [office suites][186] staple, showing how Microsoft Word
continues to function as a reliable [productivity ][187]and **document management** tool today. This
app still shapes how people draft letters, reports, and long-form content, balancing powerful
formatting options with an interface that feels approachable for everyday writing needs.

Microsoft Word stands out as more than just a typing space, particularly within **teaching &
training**, **client communication**, and broader **document management** workflows. The app has
matured into a dependable writing environment where collaboration, layout control, and file
compatibility are just as important as the fundamentals of word processing.

### A trusted tool for written work 

Microsoft Word benefits from a **clean interface**,** logical menus**, and **consistent shortcuts**
that make navigation intuitive for both beginners and experienced users. Core tasks like formatting
text, managing styles, and inserting tables feel streamlined and predictable. However, the depth of
options can feel **overwhelming at first**, especially when advanced layout, review, or reference
tools appear during simple writing sessions for new users exploring features gradually over time
comfortably. 

As a productivity and office suites tool, the program** handles large documents **reliably,
including reports with images, footnotes, tables, and tracked changes.** Real-time collaboration**
is smooth and practical, particularly for shared editing, commenting, and version awareness. That
said, **performance** **can** **dip** slightly when documents become extremely complex or heavily
formatted, which may slow editing momentum during extended work sessions for teams, students, and
professional writing environments overall today. 

### Collaboration, cloud integration, and constant evolution 

Modern versions of Microsoft Word emphasize teamwork through Microsoft 365 integration. Files saved
to OneDrive allow multiple users to edit simultaneously while tracking changes in real time.
Comments and revision history make collaborative editing smoother, supporting **real time
collaboration** for remote teams and shared projects. This cloud functionality ensures documents
remain accessible across devices, from desktops to mobile apps. Still, reliance on online features
require constant internet connection. 

Updates have introduced** AI assisted writing features** through **Microsoft** **Copilot**
integration. These updates added content suggestions, automatic summaries, and improved rewriting
assistance directly inside documents. Patch notes also included performance optimizations for large
files, improved **PDF** **editing** **support**, expanded accessibility tools such as improved
screen reader compatibility, and enhanced collaboration stability. **Security** **updates**
strengthened protection against malicious documents, reflecting Microsoft’s ongoing focus on **AI
powered writing assistance** while maintaining document safety and reliability.

The everyday standard for modern writing 

Microsoft Word continues to prove why it remains the default choice for document creation across
schools, businesses, and personal use. Its blend of familiar tools, powerful formatting, and
evolving collaboration features keeps it relevant in a changing digital workspace. While advanced
options and cloud reliance may not suit everyone, Word still delivers a dependable writing
environment that balances tradition, productivity, and modern workflow demands effectively.

Founded in 1951 by Bill Moog with a bold vision to empower people and solve tough problems through
trust and innovation, our company grew from a small airplane hangar in East Aurora into a global
leader in aerospace, defense, industrial automation, and medical technology. Through change and
challenge, Moog has remained committed to innovation and culture. Today, we continue to shape the
way our world moves while building a sustainable business for generations to come.

Featured Article: [David Trimble][6]
Lord Trimble official portrait, 2018
**William David Trimble, Baron Trimble,** PC (October 15, 1944 - July 24, 2022), was a politician
from [Northern Ireland][7] who served as leader of the Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) and the first
First Minister of Northern Ireland. He shared the 1998 [Nobel Peace Prize][8] with [John Hume][9] of
the Social Democratic and Labour Party. On June 6, 2006, he became a member of the House of Lords as
The Right Honourable William David Trimble by the name, style and title of Baron Trimble, of
Lisnagarvey in the County of Antrim. Although a staunch [Protestant][10] and member of the Orange
Order, Trimble was able to reach across both the religious and the political divide to enter peace
negotiations and to agree a new power-sharing system of governance.
Popular Article: [Ion][11]
The Earth's "plasma fountain," showing [oxygen][12], [helium][13], and [hydrogen][14] ions that gush
into space from regions near the Earth's poles. The faint yellow material above the [North Pole][15]
represents gas lost from Earth into space; the green material is the aurora borealis—or [plasma][16]
energy pouring back into the atmosphere.
An **ion** is an [atom][17], group of atoms, or [subatomic particle][18] with a net electric charge.
An ion with a net positive charge is called a **cation**; one with a net negative charge is called
an **anion**. The atoms of [metals][19] tend to form cations, and the atoms of [nonmetals][20] tend
to form anions, but there are some exceptions. Ions of opposite charges attract each other. When a
cation forms a chemical bond ("ionic bond") with an anion, an **ionic compound** is produced. A body
of ionized matter, or a gas containing a proportion of charged particles, is called a
**[plasma][21]**.
Did you know?

True matriarchal societies were, and are, extremely rare (source: [Matriarchy][22])

## Welcome

NIOA is a privately-owned global munitions company. Established in Queensland, Australia in 1973,
today the NIOA Group has strategic locations around the world. We are dedicated to the best practice
supply and manufacture of firearms, weapons and munitions to Australian and allied nation defence
forces, law enforcement agencies and commercial markets.

-

At NIOA, our engineering capability is crucial in ensuring the systems we deliver meet the highest
standards of safety and performance. Mark Donaldson VC emphasises the importance of this testing and
validation for operational success. By considering the harshest environments and induced life-cycle
threats, our team ensures that every weapon system is ready to perform when it matters most. NIOA –
Our People. Our Capability.

# Protecting those
# who protect us

## About Us

At SMPP, our mission is to deliver sophisticated and high-quality defense products that meet the
ever-evolving needs of our clients, reinforcing their trust in our technological capabilities and
unwavering commitment to excellence.

[Know Our Story][29]

## WHAT WE DO

Our passion lies in the confidence our products instill in users. We are committed to offering
technologically advanced, high-quality products and solutions, leveraging our expertise to meet our
customers' diverse needs.

##### Personal Protection

Our personal protection products include bullet-resistant jackets, armor plates, ballistic helmets,
and shields. These products are tailored for armed forces, police, and paramilitary personnel,
offering protection against various threats in different environments.

[Know More ][30]

##### Platform Protection

We provide armor solutions for vehicles, patrol boats, aircraft, and helicopters. These protection
kits are designed to enhance survivability during combat and anti-terror operations, ensuring
critical areas are shielded against blasts and projectiles.

[Know More ][31]

##### Ammunition

In the Ammunition vertical, we are the oldest Private sector company in India to manufacture
Combustible Cartridge Cases (CCCs) of 120mm and 125mm calibers for Tanks, 105mm (MCS), 130mm (MCS)
and 155mm (BMCS/UMCS) calibers for Artillery Guns and Augmenting Cartridges for 51mm, 81mm and 120mm
Mortars for Infantry and Artillery.

[Know More ][32]

##### Ceramic Plates

We manufacture bullet-resistant hard armor plates using boron carbide ceramics. These lightweight
plates provide advanced protection, including resistance to armor-piercing bullets, and are used
across various defense and industrial applications.

[Know More ][33]

## What People Say About Us

SMPP - Proudly serving armed forces with
ballistic protection solutions | DEFEXPO 2020



Major Gen. Anil Oberoi President of SMPP about manufacturing large caliber ammunitions and Artillery

Mr. Ashish Kansal, Executive Director SMPP discussed about specialty and Next-Gen product range.

## Awards & Recognition of Excellence

National Award for Indigenisation for the year 1996-1997 from the Department of Defence Production
and Supplies, Ministry of Defence, Government of India 1998

Defence Technology Absorption Award for the year 2016 from Department of Defence R&D, Ministry of
Defence, Government of India 2018

SIDM Championship Award for technology product innovation to address defence capability gaps 2020

Recognised by the Ministry of Defence, Government of India for the supply of 100,000th bullet proof
jacket to Indian Armed Forces, four months ahead of delivery schedule 2021

BIS certification as per BIS 17051:2018 standards for bullet resistant jackets 2022

Award for being one of the Top 10 Defence Manufacturers by Industry Outlook. 2023

BA 9000:2016 (quality management system for various products) certification and NIJ compliance
(certain of our models have been approved as per NIJ 01010.06 and have been listed on the Compliant
Product List of National Institute of Justice, USA) 2024

# Protecting those
# who protect us

## About Us

At SMPP, our mission is to deliver sophisticated and high-quality defense products that meet the
ever-evolving needs of our clients, reinforcing their trust in our technological capabilities and
unwavering commitment to excellence.

[Know Our Story][29]

## WHAT WE DO

Our passion lies in the confidence our products instill in users. We are committed to offering
technologically advanced, high-quality products and solutions, leveraging our expertise to meet our
customers' diverse needs.

##### Personal Protection

Our personal protection products include bullet-resistant jackets, armor plates, ballistic helmets,
and shields. These products are tailored for armed forces, police, and paramilitary personnel,
offering protection against various threats in different environments.

[Know More ][30]

##### Platform Protection

We provide armor solutions for vehicles, patrol boats, aircraft, and helicopters. These protection
kits are designed to enhance survivability during combat and anti-terror operations, ensuring
critical areas are shielded against blasts and projectiles.

[Know More ][31]

##### Ammunition

In the Ammunition vertical, we are the oldest Private sector company in India to manufacture
Combustible Cartridge Cases (CCCs) of 120mm and 125mm calibers for Tanks, 105mm (MCS), 130mm (MCS)
and 155mm (BMCS/UMCS) calibers for Artillery Guns and Augmenting Cartridges for 51mm, 81mm and 120mm
Mortars for Infantry and Artillery.

[Know More ][32]

##### Ceramic Plates

We manufacture bullet-resistant hard armor plates using boron carbide ceramics. These lightweight
plates provide advanced protection, including resistance to armor-piercing bullets, and are used
across various defense and industrial applications.

[Know More ][33]

## What People Say About Us

SMPP - Proudly serving armed forces with
ballistic protection solutions | DEFEXPO 2020



Major Gen. Anil Oberoi President of SMPP about manufacturing large caliber ammunitions and Artillery

Mr. Ashish Kansal, Executive Director SMPP discussed about specialty and Next-Gen product range.

## Awards & Recognition of Excellence

National Award for Indigenisation for the year 1996-1997 from the Department of Defence Production
and Supplies, Ministry of Defence, Government of India 1998

Defence Technology Absorption Award for the year 2016 from Department of Defence R&D, Ministry of
Defence, Government of India 2018

SIDM Championship Award for technology product innovation to address defence capability gaps 2020

Recognised by the Ministry of Defence, Government of India for the supply of 100,000th bullet proof
jacket to Indian Armed Forces, four months ahead of delivery schedule 2021

BIS certification as per BIS 17051:2018 standards for bullet resistant jackets 2022

Award for being one of the Top 10 Defence Manufacturers by Industry Outlook. 2023

BA 9000:2016 (quality management system for various products) certification and NIJ compliance
(certain of our models have been approved as per NIJ 01010.06 and have been listed on the Compliant
Product List of National Institute of Justice, USA) 2024

**high-quality forgings and machined products** for diverse industries, including **Defence,
Artillery & Ammunition, Oil & Gas, Automotive, Aerospace, and General Engineering.**

[Forging Manufacturers in India, Usai Forge]










USAI Forge specializes in high-precision empty bomb shell production for the Artillery & Ammunition
industry..

meeting the API Specifications 7-1..
[more...][19]

requirements..
